content: लासक {%a.%} (-सिका|{%f.%}) [लस्-ण्वुल्] .²1 Playing, frolicking, sporting. .²2 Moving hither and thither. .²3 Causing to dance; लासकः पादपानां … नभस्वान् <ls>Ṛs. 2. 26</ls> (the commentator Amarakīrti, however, says, “लासकः संसर्गवान्”). .{@-कः@} .²1 A dancer. .²2 A peacock. .²3 Embracing. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .{@-कम्@} A room on the top of a building, turret.
